case.title: Edit Work Order saves a new lead and a new mileage together
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Technicians [Tech-A] and [Tech-B] (the expected results call them "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" (this case only) with a contact and an asset.
  • One Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], with Mileage 120,000.
  • Names and numbers are examples, except names the expected results quote, which must be used exactly.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: two, [Tech-A] and [Tech-B].
  2. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  3. Work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > its asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In New Line > "What Are You Doing?" type "grease" and pick "Service - Full grease service" (no parts) > Line Approved on > Save & Close. Write down the number (top left) as [WO-1] ("S1-712" in the expected results).
  4. On [WO-1], in the card at the left, pick [Tech-A] in Lead Technician (it saves at once; it can only be changed once the work order is Approved).
  5. In the same card click Mileage, type 120000 and click outside the field (it saves when you leave it).
  6. Check: reload [WO-1]. Lead Technician reads [Tech-A] and Mileage reads 120,000.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] (Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > click the work order).
  2. There is no separate Edit Work Order window; the edits are made on the status card (the card at the left of the work order page that shows the status, Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours).
  3. On the status card click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-B]. It saves at once.
  4. On the status card click Mileage, change it to 120500 and click outside the field (it saves when you leave it).
  5. Watch for any error message.
  6. Reload the page and read Lead Technician and Mileage on the status card.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 to 5: both changes save with no error message.
  • Step 6: Lead Technician reads "Ralph Edwards" and Mileage reads 120,500. Both changes were saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead decision, 9 Oct 2026: there is no separate Edit Work Order window for an existing work order; the lead technician, mileage and engine hours are changed on the card at the left of the work order page.

  • QA handoff §7: “A successful change shows the new lead.”
